in_sanskrit.name: शुक्
in_sanskrit.meaning: शुक् (शुक्ति) = सुखम् (सुखम् अतिवाहनम्) = सुखम् (सुखम् सुखदायकम्) = सुखम् (सुखम् शान्तिर्निधानम्)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the cause of happiness, peace, prosperity, and well-being.

in_tamil.meaning: ஸுக் (ஸுகம்) = ஸுகம் (ஸுகம் அவ்வாறுக்குறியத்தம்) = ஸுகம் (ஸுகம் உடன்முகத்தின் மூலம்) = ஸுகம் (ஸுகம் ஷாந்திர்நிதானம்)
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is the cause of happiness, peace, prosperity, and well-being.

in_telugu.name: శుఖ

in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the cause of happiness, peace, prosperity, and well-being.

in_marathi.name: Sukh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। That which brings happiness, peace, and pleasure.

in_bengali.name: Sukh

in_bengali.long_meaning: Sukh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। That which brings happiness, peace, and pleasure.
